editorial.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara: Dulquer Salmaan Shines in a Heartfelt Journey of Dreams
editorial.excerpt: A tender exploration of aspirations and love that resonates deeply.
editorial.image_caption: Still from the official trailer of 'Aakasamlo Oka Tara'.
editorial.nri_angle: The film's themes of ambition and love resonate deeply with the Indian diaspora, making it a relatable watch for those navigating their own dreams.

just_in.title: Norse Atlantic's Norwegian Arm Files for Bankruptcy as Lessors Terminate All 787 Leases
just_in.excerpt: Flights have been suspended since November 26; the parent company and UK subsidiary sit outside the filing while the airline contests the termination of leases on its 12 Dreamliners.
just_in.image_caption: A Norse Atlantic Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner in flight.
just_in.nri_angle: Norse's last scheduled US route was London Gatwick-Orlando and it wet-leased aircraft to IndiGo until November 1; US and UK travellers holding bookings are directly affected by the suspension.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Taliban Reportedly Bars Women's Names From Records in Afghan Province
just_in.excerpt: Officials and healthcare workers in Balkh province have reportedly been told to replace women's first names with the generic 'Bibi' in documents, medical records and prescriptions, with activists reporting degrading animal labels in some cases.
just_in.image_caption: Afghan women in burqas carry children along a street in Kandahar, in a file photograph.
just_in.nri_angle: A world story with no direct reader action; it documents a reported further restriction on Afghan women's legal and medical identity.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Ships Struck Twice in Hormuz as Repeat Attacks Test Tanker Traffic
just_in.excerpt: At least six vessels have been hit more than once in two months in the Strait of Hormuz, consultants say. Whether the repeats are deliberate deterrence or the arithmetic of a shrinking target pool is disputed, but traffic through the chokepoint has not stopped.
just_in.image_caption: Cargo ships sit at anchor at sunset in a file photograph of Gulf shipping.
just_in.nri_angle: Gulf crude flows through Hormuz supply India and Asia; sustained disruption feeds into fuel and freight prices diaspora readers pay.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Second Bisleri Sample Found Unsafe as FSSAI Sanctions Prosecution Over Bacteria
just_in.excerpt: A batch from Bisleri's West Bengal plant tested positive for coliform bacteria in two laboratories, the regulator has barred its sale and sanctioned prosecution, and the company says its own independent tests found the same batch safe.
just_in.image_caption: A shrink-wrapped pack of Bisleri packaged drinking water bottles.
just_in.nri_angle: For diaspora readers travelling to India or buying for family there: the sale ban covers Bisleri batch PB 201 only; check the batch number on the bottle.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

FSSAI notice prohibits sale of batch PB 201; Bisleri recalls the batch in August

just_in.title: US Measles Cases Pass 6,000 in 2026 as CDC Counts Nine Deaths
just_in.excerpt: The CDC counted 6,039 confirmed cases as of November 24 — more than the whole of 2025 — with 97% of cases tied to outbreaks across 47 jurisdictions.
just_in.image_caption: The sign outside the headquarters of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The CDC counted 6,039 confirmed measles cases in the United States in 2026 as of November 24.
just_in.nri_angle: With 6,039 confirmed US cases and holiday travel ahead, diaspora families should confirm MMR vaccination for children and travelling relatives.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Measles Killed 32 Baiga Children in Madhya Pradesh as Vaccination Lagged
just_in.excerpt: In Balaghat's forest blocks, measles-rubella coverage ran between 49% and 70% — far below the WHO's 95% herd-immunity threshold — and distance, migration and fragile trust kept children unprotected.
just_in.image_caption: Archival photograph: young Baiga women in traditional dress in India. A measles outbreak in the Baiga community of Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, reportedly killed 32 children this year.
just_in.nri_angle: The outbreak is a reminder for families in India and abroad to check that children's two measles-rubella doses are complete; local ASHA workers and ANMs can confirm missed doses.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Supreme Court to Hear Arguments Wednesday on State Bans on AR-15 Rifles
just_in.excerpt: Challenges to Connecticut's and Cook County's assault-style weapon bans reach the 6-3 conservative court, in a case that turns on whether America's most popular rifle is in 'common use' — and therefore cannot be banned.
just_in.image_caption: The United States Supreme Court building in Washington, D.C., photographed at dusk.
just_in.nri_angle: The decision will set the reach of the Second Amendment for every state ban in the country, including in states with large Indian-American populations such as Illinois, New Jersey and California.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Foreign Investors Pour a Record Rs 1.42 Lakh Crore Into Indian Stocks in November
just_in.excerpt: NSDL data show foreign buying through November 24 has passed every previous monthly record, reversing Rs 70,704 crore of selling in September and October.
just_in.image_caption: A hand works on a tablet displaying market charts and figures.
just_in.nri_angle: Record foreign buying has lifted the Sensex and Nifty sharply in November, directly affecting the India allocations held by NRI investors.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: UK Study Visa Refusal Rate Hits 6.4%, Highest in Over a Decade
just_in.excerpt: Home Office data for the year to September 2026 show refusals more than doubling in a year, withdrawals up nearly fivefold in the peak quarter, and credibility interviews failing four in five applicants called.
just_in.image_caption: Chart: total long-term non-EU immigration to the UK by visa type, December 2019 to December 2025 — as UK study visa refusals hit 6.4%, the highest rate in over a decade.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian students are one of the largest groups applying to UK universities, and a 6.4% refusal rate — with credibility interviews deciding most cases — changes how families should prepare an application.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Zelenskyy Warns of Major New Russian Strike as Trump Urges Putin to Pull Back
just_in.excerpt: Ukraine says Russia is completing preparations for a massive strike on its energy grid. Trump says he pressed Putin in China to end military aggression across Europe, while his envoys describe the peace talks as deadlocked over territory.
just_in.image_caption: During a working trip to Kharkiv region, President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy visited the frontline command post of the defenders of Kupyansk and presented state awards. "Unfortunately, we have information about a new mass strike being prepared by the Russians," Zelenskyy said in his nightly video address, according to Al Jazeera.
just_in.image_credit: Photo: President Of Ukraine from Україна via Wikimedia Commons (CC0)
just_in.nri_angle: The warning concerns Ukraine's power grid heading into winter; there is no direct action for diaspora readers.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Women Will Get 33% Reservation, Congress Cannot Stop It, Amit Shah Says
just_in.excerpt: Speaking on Constitution Day, the Home Minister blamed the Congress for blocking the amendments needed to operationalise the 2023 women's quota law. The Congress says it backed the law and wants it implemented immediately.
just_in.image_caption: Archival photograph: Union Home Minister Amit Shah in Raigad.
just_in.nri_angle: The quota, once in force, reserves one-third of Lok Sabha and assembly seats for women; its start date turns on the delimitation bills before Parliament from November 30.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Nepal Begins Process to Declare 213 Missing Indians Presumed Dead After August Floods
just_in.excerpt: Kathmandu has published the missing list from the August 26 Trishuli-Bhotekoshi flash floods. Families of missing Indians have until December 2 to file objections with the Indian Embassy before declarations of death are issued.
just_in.image_caption: Floodwater inundates a town in Nepal, submerging streets and reaching the ground floors of buildings along the river.
just_in.nri_angle: Families of the 213 missing Indians have a December 2 deadline to check the official list and contact the Indian Embassy in Kathmandu.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India's Rice Prices Surge Despite Record Stocks of 55 Million Tonnes
just_in.excerpt: Southern premium varieties such as Sona Masoori have nearly doubled in a year after a weak monsoon, while the government's record reserves hold mostly common rice that southern consumers do not buy.
just_in.image_caption: A worker pours rice grain at a warehouse in India.
just_in.nri_angle: India supplies nearly 40% of global rice trade, so export curbs to cool domestic prices could tighten overseas supplies of premium varieties like Sona Masoori.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Black Sea Incidents Surge Tenfold, Raising Risk NATO Is Drawn Into War
just_in.excerpt: Drones, mines and ship attacks in the Black Sea have risen from fewer than 50 incidents in 2025 to as many as 500 this year, NATO's spokesperson told CBS News, on a sea bordered by three alliance members.
just_in.image_caption: Archival satellite photograph: the Black Sea from orbit, taken by NASA in May 2004.
just_in.nri_angle: Disruption to Black Sea grain and fuel shipping would feed into global food and fuel prices, including in the US.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.nri_angle: US theatrical release tracking for diaspora audiences.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: At 75 and 63, They Married at the Bilaspur Old-Age Home Where They Met
just_in.excerpt: Kanhaiya Lal, rescued from a forest after his wife's death, and Sabina, who reached Himachal from Kolkata with no one to claim her, wed at Apna Ghar in Dayoli on November 25 — and will now move to a new home in Nalagarh together.
just_in.image_caption: Kanhaiya Lal and Sabina in wedding dress at Apna Ghar Old Age Home in Dayoli, Bilaspur, on November 25, 2026. The two residents of the home married there after meeting as fellow residents.
just_in.nri_angle: A story about companionship and care in old age that resonates with diaspora families supporting elderly parents back in India.

just_in.title: 'Aachi Aachi': First Song From Mani Ratnam's Inji Vellam Is Out
just_in.excerpt: AR Rahman's first single for the Vijay Sethupathi–Sai Pallavi Tamil romance introduces Pallavi's pregnant character in a hand-drawn lyric video, two months before the January 29, 2027 release.
just_in.image_caption: Sai Pallavi, centre in pink, dances with a group of pregnant women in a still from the 'Aachi Aachi' lyric video.
just_in.nri_angle: A Mani Ratnam–AR Rahman Tamil release with a worldwide theatrical date diaspora audiences can plan around.

just_in.title: Anthropic's 'Compute Multipliers' Put the AI Infrastructure Boom in Question
just_in.excerpt: Anthropic's IPO filing says its researchers are squeezing more AI from less compute — great for its margins, and an uncomfortable question for the chip and data-centre trade built on ever-rising demand.
just_in.image_caption: Rows of server racks inside a data centre. Anthropic's IPO filing says its researchers are reducing the compute needed to serve a given level of model performance.

sources.label: Traders MBA — Anthropic compute efficiency analysis of SEC filings

just_in.nri_angle: Diaspora tech workers and investors track Anthropic as a leading AI employer and a bellwether for AI infrastructure spending.

news.title: SOG Busts Fake Medical Degree Racket That Sold MBBS, MD Credentials to Around 300
news.excerpt: Rajasthan's SOG arrested four people, including a Class 11 dropout police say worked as a junior resident at Safdarjung Hospital — a claim the hospital categorically denies.
news.nri_angle: Families in India and abroad rely on hospital credentials being real; the case shows how to verify a doctor's medical council registration before treatment.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Rajasthan Medical Council registrar files a complaint at Jaipur's Ashok Nagar police station over registrations obtained with forged documents.
Ramkishore Mahawar arrested in Delhi; further arrests follow across states through November.

news.title: Pakistan's Space Push With China's Help Must Shape India's Planning, Says CDS
news.excerpt: General N S Raja Subramani told a New Delhi seminar that Chinese ISR, navigation and timing capabilities will be available to Pakistan, and pointed to the SBS-3 surveillance programme as India's answer.
news.nri_angle: The CDS's planning assumption — a combined China-Pakistan space capability — will shape India's defence procurement and its growing private space sector.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Naidu Says South's Share Won't Shrink Under 50% Lok Sabha Seat Rise
news.excerpt: Backing the Centre's delimitation plan, the Andhra Pradesh chief minister said South India's seats would rise from 129 to 195 while its 23.76% share of the Lok Sabha stays exactly the same.
news.image_caption: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu, right, with JD(S) leader H. D. Kumaraswamy at their joint press conference in New Delhi. Naidu urged all parties to back the Delimitation Bill and its 50% Lok Sabha seat increase.
news.nri_angle: Delimitation decides how much weight southern states — the home states of much of the US Indian diaspora — carry in the Lok Sabha for the next generation.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Cabinet Clears Delimitation Bill With 50% Seat Rise for Every State, Freeze Till 2051
news.excerpt: The Union Cabinet on Friday cleared a fresh Constitution Amendment Bill linking women's reservation to delimitation, with a uniform 50% increase in Lok Sabha seats for every state and the existing inter-state ratio sealed until 2051. The bill goes before a special sitting of Parliament beginning November 30.
news.nri_angle: The bill would reshape Lok Sabha representation and activate 33% women's reservation; diaspora readers with family constituencies in India will see boundaries and seat counts change only if the amendment clears both Houses in the November 30 sitting.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Special sitting: Lok Sabha meets (also December 1)
Special sitting: Rajya Sabha meets (also December 3)

news.title: Election Commission Fixes Website Flaw That Exposed Voter Data, Reuters Finds
news.excerpt: A call-booking feature on the ECI website leaked voters' personal details and identity-document file paths through predictable form reference numbers. Reuters alerted the commission on October 26; the flaw was fixed within hours on Thursday.
news.nri_angle: NRIs who enrol or update voter details through the ECI portal are among the users whose submitted identity documents passed through the affected feature.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Bhopal Scientists Build India's First Indigenous H5N1 Vaccine for Chickens
news.excerpt: ICAR-NIHSAD's inactivated vaccine targets clade 2.3.2.1a, the strain behind most Indian bird flu outbreaks, and is expected to cost around Rs 1-2 a dose once it is manufactured.
news.nri_angle: A home-grown, low-cost bird flu vaccine strengthens disease control for India's poultry sector, on which egg and chicken prices and farmer livelihoods depend.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Putin Links Kerala Teen's AI Work to Modi's 'Make in India' at Moscow Conference
news.excerpt: Russian President Vladimir Putin told 16-year-old Raul John Aju that his AI tools help young people find their own solutions, after the Kochi student argued students should master the basics before leaning on AI.
news.nri_angle: A Class 12 student from Kochi fielding questions from two heads of state in Moscow is a marker of how far India's young AI builders are travelling.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Takes Forward Six Urea Plants Under NIPU-2026 in Push for Self-Reliance
news.excerpt: Six brownfield projects of 12.7 lakh tonnes each — replacing units up to 60 years old — aim to narrow the gap between India's ~400 LMT urea demand and domestic output.
news.image_caption: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw addresses a press conference on Union Cabinet decisions in New Delhi. The decisions included taking forward six brownfield urea projects under the National Investment Policy for Urea (NIPU)-2026.
news.nri_angle: Expanded domestic urea capacity targets India's fertiliser security and import bill, a cost line that flows through to food prices.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Madras Fertilizers' plant in Chennai is over 60 years old and will be replaced.
NFL Nangal's plant is 50-55 years old with a current capacity of 4.73 LMT/year, to be replaced by a 12.7 LMT unit.
Brownfield sites enable faster execution and cost efficiency, saving an estimated ₹225 crore annually.
Domestic urea production rose from 225 LMT in 2014-15 to a record 314.07 LMT in 2023-24.
The investment framework sets a return on equity band of 12-16 percent.

news.title: Supreme Court Orders Separate 'High Fat, High Sugar, High Salt' Warnings on Packaged Foods
news.excerpt: A bench of Justices JB Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran directed the FSSAI to mandate a separate pictorial hexagon for each nutrient, judged on total sugars and saturated fat, and to report progress on draft regulations in ten weeks.
news.image_caption: Packaged snack foods, soft drinks and chocolates sold under international brands.
news.nri_angle: The labelling regime will apply to packaged foods sold across India, including the snacks and sweets diaspora families buy on visits home and in Indian grocery stores abroad.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

FSSAI to reformulate nutrient thresholds, not adopt Dietary Guidelines for India 2024 values

dates.event: Judgment reserved in public interest litigation

news.title: US Would Cap India Tariff at 17% If Trade Deal Is Reached, USTR Says
news.excerpt: USTR Jamieson Greer said Indian goods would face 25% if no deal is reached. India replied that it has no structural excess capacity in any sector and wants an early deal.
news.nri_angle: The conditional 17% cap sets the ceiling Indian exporters and US importers of Indian goods will plan around while the trade deal is negotiated.

immigration.title: Supreme Court Agrees to Hear Challenge to Trump's Border Asylum Ban
immigration.excerpt: The justices will decide whether President Trump's January 2025 proclamation lawfully shut off asylum at the southern border — a policy two lower courts rejected but that remains in force, with a ruling expected by summer 2027.
immigration.image_caption: The United States Supreme Court building in Washington, D.C., photographed at dusk. The court agreed on November 13 to decide whether the president's border asylum ban is lawful.
immigration.nri_angle: The ruling will define how far a president's border-emergency powers reach over the asylum process — a pathway used by many Indian and other diaspora families' relatives fleeing persecution.

immigration.nri_angle: Indian students are one of the largest groups applying to UK universities, and a 6.4% refusal rate — with credibility interviews deciding most cases — changes how families should prepare an application.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: UK Net Migration Falls to 77,000, Its Lowest Level Since 1997
immigration.excerpt: Provisional ONS figures for the year to June 2026 show net migration more than halved in a year, driven by fewer non-EU arrivals for work and study — with Indians still the largest non-EU nationality coming to Britain.
immigration.image_caption: A traveller walks through an airport departure terminal at sunset.
immigration.nri_angle: Indians remain the largest non-EU nationality moving to the UK even as overall net migration hits a near-three-decade low, with study still the main route in.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Second Judge Blocks Trump's New Birthright Citizenship Order
immigration.excerpt: Judge Christopher Cooper's injunction bars three federal agencies from enforcing the August order against children in the class action, joining a Maryland block issued in September.
immigration.image_caption: File photograph: protesters hold a 'Hands Off Birthright Citizenship' banner outside the US Supreme Court in Washington during earlier demonstrations over the policy.
immigration.nri_angle: Children born in the US to parents in the order's new categories — including foreign-government and international-organization staff — remain citizens while both injunctions stand.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Boston Man Wins $1 Million Lottery Prize, Then ICE Arrests Him
immigration.excerpt: Ariel Velasquez-Morales claimed a $1 million Massachusetts Lottery prize on November 18. Six days later ICE arrested him in East Boston under a removal order issued in 2014.
immigration.image_caption: Ariel Velasquez-Morales, the East Boston man who won a $1 million Massachusetts Lottery prize. ICE arrested him on November 24 under a removal order issued in 2014.
immigration.nri_angle: A final removal order never expires: ICE executed a 2014 order against a man whose only new visibility was a lottery winner's photograph.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Canada Invites 6,000 French-Speaking Candidates at CRS Cut-Off of 401
immigration.excerpt: The November 25 Express Entry draw was the 13th French-language round of 2026, taking the category to 66,500 invitations this year, with a profile cut-off of September 12.
immigration.nri_angle: For Indian applicants in Canada's pool, the French-language category remains the lowest cut-off route to an invitation, at 401 against 519 for the last Canadian Experience Class draw.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Louisiana Visa Fraud Ringleader Patel Sentenced to 10 Years, Faces Removal
immigration.excerpt: Chandrakant Patel recruited foreign nationals and paid four Louisiana law-enforcement leaders to certify fictitious armed robbery reports supporting fraudulent U visa applications, USCIS said.
immigration.nri_angle: A fraud built on fake U visa claims warns diaspora applicants against paid intermediaries promising status through fabricated documents.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.nri_angle: More airlines and capacity on India routes would mean more competition — and potentially better fares and schedules — for diaspora travellers flying to India.

markets-finance.title: Sensex Falls 989 Points as IT Profit-Taking, Oil and a Weak Rupee End Two-Day Rally

markets-finance.title: RBI Restores 90% Daily CRR Floor From December 1, Reversing October Tightening
markets-finance.excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India has cut the minimum daily cash reserve maintenance requirement from 99% to 90% of the prescribed CRR, effective from the fortnight beginning December 1, 2026, as banking-system liquidity swings from surplus to deficit. The CRR rate itself stays at 3%.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The change affects how Indian banks manage day-to-day cash, not deposit rates directly; NRI depositors face no action, but the move signals the RBI sees tighter liquidity heading into December.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Global Brands Shift About $254 Million in Orders From Bangladesh to India Amid Unrest

markets-finance.nri_angle: The diversion puts more orders into India's garment hubs and lifted Indian textile stocks, a shift diaspora investors and families with ties to the apparel trade are watching.

markets-finance.title: Foreign Investors Pour a Record Rs 1.42 Lakh Crore Into Indian Stocks in November

food.title: FSSAI Suspends Licences of Five Nutraceutical Makers Over Safety Violations
food.excerpt: Vedant Remedies scored 12% on compliance and two makers were not operating from their licensed premises at all, the food regulator said, suspending all five licences with immediate effect.
food.nri_angle: Diaspora shoppers who buy Indian-made supplements can check the maker name on the label against the five suspended manufacturers.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Jaipur's Vinita Somani Cooked Through Chemotherapy, Then Trained Nearly 200 Women
food.excerpt: Diagnosed with breast cancer in 2011 after losing both parents and an aunt to the disease, she built a garage-kitchen hobby into Appetite, a bakery school branch, and a second career supporting other patients.
food.nri_angle: A Jaipur home chef's garage-kitchen classes became a training pipeline through which nearly 200 women now earn from baking and cooking.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

rows: Days of bakery workshop in July 2026
data_cards.title: Women Empowered Through Cooking

food.title: Krish Ashok Takes Food Myths From the Kitchen to the Body in 'Masala Body'
food.excerpt: The Masala Lab author's new book explains what the stomach, liver and intestines actually do, so readers can test the next frightening food forward themselves.
food.image_caption: Author Krish Ashok with his new book, Masala Body: An Engineer's Guide to Eating. The book applies first-principles science to digestion and nutrition myths.
food.nri_angle: Ashok's science-first approach helps diaspora cooks adapt Indian recipes to substituted ingredients and different kitchens abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Norse Atlantic's Norwegian Arm Files for Bankruptcy as Lessors Terminate All 787 Leases
travel.excerpt: Flights have been suspended since November 26; the parent company and UK subsidiary sit outside the filing while the airline contests the termination of leases on its 12 Dreamliners.
travel.image_caption: A Norse Atlantic Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner in flight.
travel.nri_angle: Norse's last scheduled US route was London Gatwick-Orlando and it wet-leased aircraft to IndiGo until November 1; US and UK travellers holding bookings are directly affected by the suspension.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India CEO Gebremariam Gets Free Hand to Rebuild Senior Management
travel.excerpt: Tata Sons has backed the former Ethiopian Airlines chief to hire from outside the group and restructure Air India's top team, as a Rs 22,238 crore FY26 consolidated loss sharpens the turnaround pressure.
travel.nri_angle: For diaspora flyers on India-North America and India-Europe routes, the test of the reset is reliability and cabin quality, not the org chart.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Supreme Court Agrees to Hear Challenge to Trump's Border Asylum Ban
carousel.excerpt: The justices will decide whether President Trump's January 2025 proclamation lawfully shut off asylum at the southern border — a policy two lower courts rejected but that remains in force, with a ruling expected by summer 2027.
carousel.image_caption: The United States Supreme Court building in Washington, D.C., photographed at dusk. The court agreed on November 13 to decide whether the president's border asylum ban is lawful.
carousel.nri_angle: The ruling will define how far a president's border-emergency powers reach over the asylum process — a pathway used by many Indian and other diaspora families' relatives fleeing persecution.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Naidu Says South's Share Won't Shrink Under 50% Lok Sabha Seat Rise
carousel.excerpt: Backing the Centre's delimitation plan, the Andhra Pradesh chief minister said South India's seats would rise from 129 to 195 while its 23.76% share of the Lok Sabha stays exactly the same.
carousel.image_caption: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu, right, with JD(S) leader H. D. Kumaraswamy at their joint press conference in New Delhi. Naidu urged all parties to back the Delimitation Bill and its 50% Lok Sabha seat increase.
carousel.nri_angle: Delimitation decides how much weight southern states — the home states of much of the US Indian diaspora — carry in the Lok Sabha for the next generation.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Tanvi Sharma, Unnati Hooda Set Up All-Indian Syed Modi Semi-Final in Lucknow
carousel.excerpt: Second seed Tanvi Sharma and third seed Unnati Hooda both came through three-game quarter-finals on Friday at the Syed Modi India International Super 300, guaranteeing India a women's singles finalist. Defending champions Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand also reached the women's doubles semi-finals.
carousel.image_caption: Tanvi Sharma plays a forehand during a match at the Taipei Open. The second seed defeated Indonesia's Ni Kadek Dhinda Amartya Pratiwi in three games on Friday to set up an all-Indian semi-final against Unnati Hooda at the Syed Modi India International in Lucknow.
carousel.nri_angle: India is guaranteed a women's singles finalist at its home Super 300 in Lucknow; the semi-finals are played on Saturday, November 28, with the finals on Sunday, November 29.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Lutnick Faces Bipartisan Fire as Senators Vow Crackdown on AI Chip Leaks to China
carousel.excerpt: The Commerce Secretary has agreed to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on December 10 as lawmakers question why Singapore-based Megaspeed was never blacklisted over alleged diversion of Nvidia chips.
carousel.image_caption: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, pictured in 2025. Lutnick has agreed to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on December 10 over his department's handling of AI chip export controls.
carousel.nri_angle: Tighter US chip export controls shape the AI industry in which many diaspora engineers and investors work, and the December hearings will set the direction of enforcement.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang asked to appear before the Senate Banking Committee.

carousel.title: Adani Group Seeks Government Nod to Invest in Airlines, Reversing Earlier Stance
carousel.excerpt: CFO Jugeshinder Robbie Singh said India needs daily flights to rise nearly tenfold to 30,000, and the group wants to back a fund, an airline or an entrepreneur rather than run a carrier itself.
carousel.image_caption: Archival photograph: Adani Group chief financial officer Jugeshinder Robbie Singh speaks at a company event in November 2024.
carousel.nri_angle: More airlines and capacity on India routes would mean more competition — and potentially better fares and schedules — for diaspora travellers flying to India.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Group states in a regulatory filing it is not evaluating any proposal to enter the airlines business.
Adani Airport Holdings chief executive Arun Bansal rules out entering the airlines business.
Group CFO Jugeshinder Robbie Singh says the group has asked the government to allow it to invest in airlines.
